与账号页共用全局消耗规则: Shares global consumption rules with Accounts
与账号页共用：{rules}。积分到期等规则直接影响网关实际选路。: Shared with Accounts: {rules}. Rules such as credit expiry directly affect gateway routing.
五分钟没有往来即释放；客户端会话标识优先，内容哈希兜底。: Released after five minutes of inactivity. Client session identifiers take priority; a content hash is used as a fallback.
仅保留最后承载信息，尝试明细未记录: Only the final account is retained; attempt details were not recorded
从现有模型中创建独立配置，自动列出提供它的全部提供商；之后的修改只跟随这个模型。: Create an independent configuration for an existing model. All providers serving it are listed automatically; later changes apply only to this model.
优先使用队首账号，不可用时顺延。: Prefer the first account in the queue and fall back when it is unavailable.
会话最长保持六小时无往来；可以随时在会话粘滞中解除。: Bindings last for up to six hours of inactivity and can be released at any time under Session bindings.
保存的尝试明细中没有这次调用: This call is not present in the saved attempt details
候选与跳过清单各最多保存十二项；重试和跨账号切换见尝试明细。: Candidate and skipped lists each retain up to twelve entries. See attempt details for retries and account switches.
候选和跳过清单各最多保存十二项，超出部分不绘制。: Candidate and skipped lists each retain up to twelve entries. Additional entries are not drawn.
候选快照中有此账号，但保存的尝试明细未显示它被调用: This account appears in the candidate snapshot, but no call to it is recorded in the saved attempts
停用后保留卡片与账号，方便随时恢复；不会全局禁用提供商。: Disabling keeps the card and accounts for easy restoration. It does not disable the provider globally.
全局顺序与账号页联动，修改即时保存。: Global order stays in sync with Accounts. Changes are saved immediately.
其他账号已完成请求，没有继续调用这个候选: Another account completed the request, so this candidate was not called
内部重试不会增加账号切换节点。: Internal retries do not add account-switch nodes.
切换模型后，右侧只展示该模型的提供商与账号路由。: Switching models shows only that model's provider and account routes on the right.
历史只读，当前配置的修改不会改变这条请求的快照。: History is read-only. Configuration changes do not alter this request snapshot.
只从当前路由视图移除，不删除提供商或账号，也不改变其他模型的独立配置。: Remove only from the current routing view. Providers, accounts, and other models' independent configurations remain unchanged.
只列出当前模型已有启用绑定的提供商；这里只设置路由，不新建模型绑定。: Only providers with an enabled binding for this model are listed. This changes routing, not model bindings.
可用账号按请求轮换；开启会话粘性时同一会话优先留在原账号。: Rotate available accounts per request. With session stickiness enabled, the same session prefers its previous account.
同账号内部重试: Internal retries on the same account

启用提供商中的第 {rank} 顺位；当前没有可用候选账号。: Priority {rank} among enabled providers; no candidate accounts are currently available.
命中会话粘性，沿用原账号完成请求: Session stickiness matched; the previous account completed the request
尝试明细已截断或未记录，画布只展示保存下来的信息。: Attempt details were truncated or not recorded. The canvas shows only saved information.
已固定这条请求，新请求不会打断当前查看: This request is pinned; new requests will not interrupt this view
序号表示先后，不是提供商之间互相转发: Numbers show the order of attempts, not forwarding between providers
当前有效顺位以路由预演为准，不改变保存的配置优先级。: The current effective order follows the routing preview and does not change the saved configuration priority.
当前档位不保留跨请求粘滞，因此没有活跃绑定。: The current mode does not retain bindings across requests, so there are no active bindings.
当前模型使用独立顺序，不受全局自动消耗排序影响。删除独立路由后会重新跟随账号页。: This model uses an independent order, unaffected by global automatic consumption sorting. Deleting the independent route makes it follow Accounts again.
当前模型使用独立顺序，不受全局自动消耗排序影响。恢复继承后会重新跟随账号页。: This model uses an independent order, unaffected by global automatic consumption sorting. Restore inheritance to follow Accounts again.
当前模型配置独立保存，不影响全局和其他模型。: This model's configuration is saved independently and does not affect global settings or other models.
当前视图没有活跃会话粘滞: No active session bindings in this view

当时可用，当前请求尚未轮到这个账号: Available at the time; this request has not reached this account yet
当时的选路原因未记录: The routing reason was not recorded at the time
当时被候选过滤规则跳过: Skipped by candidate filtering rules at the time
恢复按账号页面的全局优先级选路，解除全局视图的提供商和账号范围限制。模型独立配置: Restore routing by the account page's global priority and remove provider and account restrictions from the global view. Independent model configurations remain unchanged.
所有可用提供商都已在当前路由中: All available providers are already in this route
所有模型共用路由策略与保护设置；全局顺序和消耗规则与账号页联动，模型独立配置可明: All models share routing strategies and protection settings. Global order and consumption rules stay in sync with Accounts; an independent model configuration can explicitly override the order.
拖动提供商与账号调整顺序，修改即时保存。: Drag providers and accounts to reorder them. Changes are saved immediately.
按当前视图的顺序参与选路: Routed in the order configured for this view
按步骤回放，不重新发送请求: Replay steps without sending the request again
提供商保持优先顺序，同一提供商的账号轮流承接。: Keep providers in priority order and rotate accounts within each provider.
搜索模型、账号或会话来源: Search models, accounts, or session sources
时间相对请求开始；未记录的旧数据不补算。响应到达不等于流式请求结束。: Times are relative to the request start. Missing historical data is not inferred. Receiving a response does not mean a streaming request has ended.
曾被限流的账号暂时排到队尾，三十分钟后或转发成功后恢复。: Previously rate-limited accounts move to the back temporarily and return after thirty minutes or a successful forward.
查看实际请求的选路、尝试与结果: View routing decisions, attempts, and results for actual requests
模型、网关、提供商与账号的可视化选路: Visual routing across models, the gateway, providers, and accounts

此为配置顺位，当前没有可用候选账号。: This is the configured priority; there are currently no available candidate accounts.
此提供商当前没有可用的模型绑定，配置已保留；在模型管理中恢复绑定后会自动回来。: This provider currently has no available model binding. Its configuration is retained and will return automatically when the binding is restored in Model management.
每轮重新选路，不保留跨请求的账号绑定。: Route each turn independently without retaining account bindings across requests.
没有保存其他候选信息: No other candidate information was saved
没有独立配置的模型沿用全局路由。: Models without independent configurations use the global route.
添加到全局路由，新请求将按这里的顺序选择账号。: Add to the global route. New requests select accounts in the order configured here.
点击查看这次尝试的结果与原因: Click to view this attempt result and reason
点击节点，切换到对应请求详情: Click a node to switch to its request details
确定删除「{model}」的独立路由配置？删除后该模型将使用全局路由。不会删除模: Delete the independent routing configuration for “{model}”? This model will then use the global route. No models, accounts, or request records will be deleted.
移除此模型的独立路由配置，之后重新继承全局路由。不会删除模型、账号或请求记录。: Remove this model's independent routing configuration and inherit the global route again. No models, accounts, or request records will be deleted.
网关继续尝试下一个账号: Gateway proceeds to the next account
自动消耗排序已启用，请先关闭规则再手动调整: Automatic consumption sorting is enabled. Turn off the rules before reordering manually
解除全局路由的参与范围限制，继续使用与账号页共用的手动顺序和自动消耗规则；模型独: Remove global routing participation restrictions while keeping the manual order and automatic consumption rules shared with Accounts. Independent model configurations remain unchanged.
解除只清除网关的账号绑定，不删除聊天历史、不关闭粘性设置。后续成功请求仍可建立新: Releasing clears only the gateway's account binding, not chat history or the stickiness setting. Later successful requests can create new bindings. Restarting the gateway clears these process-local records.
解除所有模型的全部会话粘滞。不会终止在途请求，之后的请求会重新选路。: Release all session bindings for all models. In-flight requests are not terminated; later requests are routed again.
解除这个模型的全部会话粘滞。不会终止在途请求，之后的请求会重新选路。: Release all session bindings for this model. In-flight requests are not terminated; later requests are routed again.
记录所有经过网关的请求，不要求绑定客户端。: Records all requests through the gateway, without requiring client bindings.
该提供商在当前视图中已停用: This provider is disabled in this view
该提供商没有账号，请先到账号页添加。: This provider has no accounts. Add one on the Accounts page first.
请检查熔断参数：失败阈值 1～20，时长 10～600 秒，恢复阈值 1～10。: Check the circuit breaker parameters: failure threshold 1–20, duration 10–600 seconds, recovery threshold 1–10.
请求仍在处理中，当前阶段：{phase}: Request is still in progress; current phase: {phase}
请求成功完成，未发生账号切换: Request completed successfully without an account switch
起点是请求本身，不依赖客户端绑定。: The request itself is the starting point; no client binding is required.
跟随列表中的最新请求: Following the latest request in the list
路由接口不可用，请确认网关与界面已更新: Routing API unavailable. Ensure both the gateway and interface are updated.
路由接口返回了不完整的数据: The routing API returned incomplete data
转发失败的账号暂时休息，避免连续请求反复撞到同一故障。: Accounts that fail to forward rest temporarily, avoiding repeated requests to the same failing account.
还没有参与路由的提供商: No providers participating in routing yet
这些设置由所有模型共用；提供商与账号的参与范围和顺序在各自视图中独立配置。: These settings are shared by all models. Provider and account participation and order are configured independently in each view.
这份记录来自实际请求，不使用当前账号队列重新推演。: This record comes from an actual request, not a simulation using the current account queue.
这是请求当时保存的选路快照，修改当前路由不会改变这份记录。: This snapshot was saved when the request was routed. Changing the current route does not change this record.
这条会话已解除或过期，不再有活跃绑定。: This session has been released or expired and no longer has an active binding.
这条请求对应的会话当前仍绑定到「{account}」。: The session for this request is currently bound to “{account}”.
这条请求没有保存上游尝试明细: No upstream attempt details were saved for this request
这条请求没有保存路由决策: No routing decision was saved for this request
这条请求没有保存路由快照，仍可查看已有的请求和尝试信息。: No routing snapshot was saved for this request. Existing request and attempt information is still available.
这里的参与范围只影响当前视图；账号启停、并发和限制器属于账号本身，所有模型共用。: Participation here affects only this view. Account enablement, concurrency, and limiters belong to the account and are shared by all models.
连续失败达到阈值时暂时让位，恢复后再重新参与。: Temporarily step aside after consecutive failures reach the threshold and participate again after recovery.
选择一条请求查看执行过程: Select a request to view its execution
选择一条请求查看选路过程: Select a request to view its routing process
队列为无会话预演；实际粘性命中和重试顺延以回放为准。: The queue is a session-free preview. Refer to replays for actual binding hits and retry fallback.
顺序修改即时保存，仅作用于当前视图。: Order changes are saved immediately and affect only this view.
停用后保留卡片与账号；自动参与不会重新启用明确停用的提供商。: Disabling keeps the card and accounts. Automatic participation does not re-enable explicitly disabled providers.
切换后，原本不在名单内的可用提供商也会参与转发。明确停用的提供商和排除的账号不会: After switching, available providers outside the previous list will also participate. Explicitly disabled providers and excluded accounts remain excluded.
只修改全局参与范围，不改变账号排序、模型开关或模型独立路由；网关 Key 权限与: Changes only global participation, not account order, model enablement, or independent model routes. Gateway Key permissions and rate limits still apply.
只有名单内的提供商可以参与；新增提供商不会自动加入。: Only listed providers can participate. New providers are not added automatically.
当前全局路由使用固定参与名单，新增提供商不会自动加入。: The global route uses a fixed participation list. New providers are not added automatically.
当前继承全局固定名单；新增提供商需手动添加或在全局配置中改为自动参与。: This view inherits the fixed global list. Add new providers manually or enable automatic participation in the global configuration.
所有可用提供商自动参与，新增账号或插件后无需再添加路由。已停用的提供商和已排除的: All available providers participate automatically. Adding accounts or plugins requires no extra routing setup. Disabled providers and excluded accounts remain unchanged.
新增可用提供商会自动参与；这里只需恢复曾明确停用的提供商。: New available providers participate automatically. Use this dialog only to restore explicitly disabled providers.
没有可用提供商，请先添加账号或安装插件。: No providers are available. Add an account or install a plugin first.
添加到固定参与名单；以后新增的提供商仍需手动加入。: Add to the fixed participation list. Future providers must still be added manually.
自动参与模式下将明确停用此提供商，之后新增账号也不会自动恢复；不会删除提供商或账: This explicitly disables the provider in automatic mode. Adding accounts later will not re-enable it. No providers or accounts are deleted.
默认自动参与；新增可用提供商无需再添加路由，明确停用项保持不变。: Participation is automatic by default. New available providers need no extra routing setup; explicitly disabled providers remain disabled.
